description: Source code for the Settings Dialog in a Qt-based application, managing UI setup, user interactions, and configuration updates.

classes.name: SettingDialog
classes.description: A dialog window for application settings, handling UI interactions and configuration updates.

methods.name: setupUi
methods.description: Initializes UI components and connects signals to slots.

methods.name: setWindowHeight
methods.description: Animates and adjusts the height of the settings dialog for different pages.

methods.name: on_pushButton_general_clicked
methods.description: Switches to the general settings page.

methods.name: on_pushButton_accountRepo_clicked
methods.description: Switches to the account/repo settings page.

methods.name: on_pushButton_edit_clicked
methods.description: Switches to the edit settings page.

methods.name: on_pushButton_shortcuts_clicked
methods.description: Switches to the shortcuts settings page.

methods.name: on_comboBox_autoSynch_currentIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates auto-sync interval based on user selection.

methods.name: on_comboBox_autoLock_currentIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates auto-lock interval based on user selection.

methods.name: getTimeByComboBoxIndex
methods.description: Converts combo box index to time in milliseconds.

methods.name: getComboBoxIndexByTime
methods.description: Converts time in milliseconds to combo box index.

methods.name: on_lineEdit_unlockPassword_editingFinished
methods.description: Saves the unlock password when editing is finished.

methods.name: on_lineEdit_repoUrl_editingFinished
methods.description: Validates and saves the repository URL.

methods.name: on_lineEdit_username_editingFinished
methods.description: Saves the repository email/username.

methods.name: on_lineEdit_password_editingFinished
methods.description: Saves the repository password.

methods.name: onCutRectKeySequenceAccepted
methods.description: Updates the cut rectangle hotkey.

methods.name: onCutWindowKeySequenceAccepted
methods.description: Updates the cut window hotkey.

methods.name: onCutFullKeySequenceAccepted
methods.description: Updates the cut full hotkey.

methods.name: onCutRectKeySequenceCleared
methods.description: Clears the cut rectangle hotkey.

methods.name: onCutWindowKeySequenceCleared
methods.description: Clears the cut window hotkey.

methods.name: onCutFullKeySequenceCleared
methods.description: Clears the cut full hotkey.

methods.name: on_pushButton_font_clicked
methods.description: Opens font dialog, updates font settings.

methods.name: on_buttonBox_rejected
methods.description: Handles dialog rejection, triggers remote repo sync.

methods.name: showEvent
methods.description: Sends analytics screen view event when dialog is shown.
